meta.what: Numbers the PRT gives a cape, stated in the serial. Numbers and chapter headings only, no prose. Found by a case-insensitive search of the local text for a class word beside a digit or a number word, then checked by eye.
meta.targetRule: A cape's target is the number beside its primary class in the sidecar's class set. A re-rated cape lists every stated value and a prediction hits when it equals (or is within one of) any of them.
